assessment.rationale: Authored simulator-world report task on synthetic native case LPN-3b4bea1567 (upstream commit c6a9225a9e551ae4e7c11c1ef056b67c6204afbd). Source pressure was reported as 13.332236800000002 Pa; converted to the native 0.1 Torr input (1 Torr = 133.322368 Pa), confirmed by the solver's 100 mTorr output. Scheduled inputs preserved: shelf -35 C initial, 1 C/min ramp to 10 C setpoint, 3600 min step; no recipe pair selected. Native run finished with dried percent ~100 (99.99999999999997) at 13.0951 h elapsed, so drying completed and completion time is that last solver node. Maximum returned vial-bottom temperature -16.80957 C at the final node (13.095 h); maximum returned front temperature identical at that node. Peak whole-batch sublimation is derived, not directly returned: maximum returned flux 0.875262 kg/h/m2 times total product area 398 vials x 3.14 cm2/vial = 0.124972 m2, giving 0.109383 kg/h. Thermal margin uses the vial-BOTTOM temperature per the source constraint observable: T_pr_crit -5 C minus max bottom -16.80957 C = 11.80957 C positive margin. Equipment line a + b*P_Torr = -0.182 + 11.7*0.1 = 0.988 kg/h whole batch at 0.1 Torr; capacity margin 0.988 - 0.109383 = 0.878617 kg/h. Native solver nodes only, no continuous-maximum guarantee; simulated result, not an experimental observation, measurement, approval or equipment operation.

output.content:
**Drying completed.** On the scheduled native inputs (shelf −35 °C initial, 1 °C/min ramp to 10 °C, 3600 min step), the primary-drying run reached ~100% dried (99.99999999999997%) at the final solver node, so:

- **Completion time: 13.095 h** (13.095104665305154 h, the last returned node)
- **Maximum returned vial-bottom temperature: −16.81 °C** (−16.809572962142063 °C, at 13.095 h; the maximum is over returned solver nodes only, with no continuous-maximum guarantee)
- **Peak whole-batch sublimation: 0.109 kg/h** (derived, not directly returned: peak flux 0.875262 kg/h/m² × 398 vials × 3.14 cm²/vial = 0.124972 m² total product area)

**Unit preparation:** the source reported chamber pressure as 13.332236800000002 Pa; I converted it to the native **0.1 Torr** input (1 Torr = 133.322368 Pa), which the solver confirmed as 100 mTorr output. The reported unit was preserved in the assessment.

Supporting figures from the same simulation: vial-bottom temperature stayed below the −5 °C critical value throughout, giving a positive thermal margin of 11.81 °C (derived: −5 − (−16.80957) = 11.80957 °C); the equipment line at 0.1 Torr is a + b·P = −0.182 + 11.7×0.1 = 0.988 kg/h whole-batch, a capacity margin of 0.879 kg/h over the peak rate (both derived).

This is an authored simulator-world calculation on a synthetic example, not experimental validation, and no measured outcome, equipment operation or approval is implied. The assessment is saved as a draft requiring review (peak figures and margins are my derivations from the returned solver values; the completion time and bottom temperature are as returned).
